title: vault-config.yaml — templates.note_include
description: Canonical input contract for `scripts/vault-config-writer.py templates-include`. The writer inserts or replaces only the `note_include` lines inside the top-level `templates:` block of vault-config.yaml (appending a `templates:` block when none exists); `base_path`, `mapping`, `custom_tokens`, comments and every other byte stay untouched. An absent key means note templates are not configured; an empty list is not accepted.

note_include.description: Filename globs, matched against template filenames under templates.base_path, that mark a template as a note template for /note.
